descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-10 Pre-Rounding Summary · S30 「通过真实 Save Note 的 AI Check，两个模式：没口述的面板保持空，今天的记录写明没口述生命体征」 AI Check through the real Save Note, both modes: undictated panels stay empty, and today's note says vitals were not dictated

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U9 AI Check: a dictation that never mentions diagnostic tests, labs or vitals leaves those panels empty or 'Not dictated', never filled with invented values; …（UAT TC-10 AI Check；TFA-92588 AC 7；UAT 3.2；UAT 3.4） — gate: blocked: TFA-92588 ready for pr
  • U14 Today's note never includes a vital or lab not refreshed today, and if no vitals were dictated today it says so. Vitals, labs and imaging each show the date they were recorded (dated panels are not o …（UAT 3.7；UAT 3.4）
  • U10 Every step works, and must pass, in both Hospital and Nursing Home.（UAT 3.3；TFA-94745 AC 6）

测试设计方法：边界值（boundary） — 卡在规则的边上（刚好到点 / 过一分钟、空、最长、最多）看行为在哪一边变。

Given The make-session Hospital patient and Nursing Home resident, nothing on file

When Type the H-03 text (Hospital) and the N-04 text (Nursing Home) from S08, Save Note, look at the Pre-Round panels, then press Generate Note & Finish and open today's note

Then Vitals, Labs and Diagnostic Testing show their empty states (Q7) in both modes; nothing invented; today's note says vitals were not dictated and invents no normals

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：scripts/oracle.mjs: the empty-state strings (Q7) on the Pre-Round tab after Save; on the note, 'Not dictated' (3.4: 'Undictated sections read Not dictated'; 3.7: 'if no vitals were dictated today, it says so') and no invented normals. This is the app's own write path for U9, so lane B (S08, 'model + exported guards') cannot hide a hook that stops calling a guard. …

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 AGENT · 浏览器 agent；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（automated）

S30 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-10.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：AGENT · 浏览器 agent；辅助：AICHECK · AI 输出检查 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 dev 跑；来源：dev。
